description: This file is the main CLI entry point for the ts-node project, handling command-line argument parsing, configuration loading, and execution of scripts, eval, or REPL sessions. It manages different phases of bootstrap, supports ESM and transpilation options, and can spawn child processes for ESM support.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes CLI processing and bootstrap phases.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Coordinates the bootstrap process, managing phases and child process spawning.

methods.name: parseArgv
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into structured options.

methods.name: phase2
methods.description: Handles initial CLI argument processing, help/version display, and ESM flag handling.

methods.name: phase3
methods.description: Loads configuration, determines entry point, and prepares environment based on CLI args.

methods.name: getEntryPointInfo
methods.description: Determines the script or eval to execute based on CLI args and process state.

methods.name: phase4
methods.description: Final execution phase: sets up REPL, eval, or script execution, and handles output.

methods.name: evalAndExitOnTsError
methods.description: Evaluates code in REPL context, handling TypeScript errors and output.
